title: Permission Pulse — Compact Audit Timeline & Cost Attribution Strip for Rollouts
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design a lightweight, single-line audit timeline (Permission Pulse) that sits in workspace and org settings and surfaces who changed role bindings, when, and the estimated incremental cost impact of the change for active rollouts. The goal is a compact component that can be embedded in rollouts/dashboards and in the audit view, giving engineers and admins a ‘quick pulse’ of access churn and immediate cost exposure without drilling into full audit logs.
acceptance_criteria: Compact timeline component (120px–640px responsive) shows time-ordered events with actor, action verb, and a cost delta chip
Hover/expand reveals full audit entry and link to detailed audit log entry
Integrates with rollout cards — when a rollout toggles a permission, Permission Pulse shows projected cost delta for the rollout cohort
Accessible: keyboard navigable, screen-reader friendly labels for event type and cost delta
Performance: initial render under 150ms for 30 recent events; lazy-load older events
decisions: Use a compact chip to show cost delta (±$X/month) instead of absolute total to reduce cognitive load
Event ordering will be strictly chronological with most-recent-on-right to match rollout timelines
Use color-coded micro-icons for action type (grant/revoke/role-edit) and a subtle red/yellow/green heat for customer-impacted events
Do not surface full policy diffs inline; link out to the audit modal to keep the strip lightweight
tradeoffs_and_risks: Risk: showing cost deltas estimated on short-term heuristics may be misleading — we must label estimates and link to the cost explainer
Tradeoff: compactness vs. discoverability. Chosen pattern favors economy of space with hover-to-expand. May reduce discoverability for new users
Performance: query for recent events needs a small, indexed API to avoid loading full audit logs on every dashboard render
implementation_notes: Frontend: React component PermissionPulseStrip with lazy-load older events; skeleton state for 0–150ms
API: graphql query recentWorkspacePermissionEvents(workspaceId, limit=30) returning actor, verb, timestamp, roleSummary, estimatedCostDelta
Backend: add precomputed cost-delta field in audit stream processor to avoid on-the-fly costing for UI requests
Telemetry: expose metrics permission_pulse_render_time_ms and permission_pulse_click_to_audit_rate
reviews_and_feedback: PM (Ben Zhao): prefer showing cost delta in relative % for large orgs. Action: add toggle in settings to view $ or %

Security (Omar Reyes): requested mandatory security_review_required before release due to RBAC surface
